function.name: manage_memory
function.description:
Create, update, or delete a memory to persist across conversations.
Include the MEMORY ID when updating or deleting a MEMORY. Omit when creating a new MEMORY - it will be created for you.
Proactively call this tool when you:

1. Identify a new USER preference.
2. Receive an explicit USER request to remember something or otherwise alter your behavior.
3. Are working and want to record important context.
4. Identify that an existing MEMORY is incorrect or outdated.
Create and update require non-null content. Update and delete require an existing memory in this user's namespace; an unchanged update makes no write.

function.description:
Create, update, or delete a memory to persist across conversations.
Include the MEMORY ID when updating or deleting a MEMORY. Omit when creating a new MEMORY - it will be created for you.
Proactively call this tool when you:

1. Identify a new USER preference.
2. Receive an explicit USER request to remember something or otherwise alter your behavior.
3. Are working and want to record important context.
4. Identify that an existing MEMORY is incorrect or outdated.
Create and update require non-null content. Update and delete require an existing memory in this user's namespace; an unchanged update makes no write.

function.name: manage_memory
function.description:
Create, update, or delete a memory to persist across conversations.
Include the MEMORY ID when updating or deleting a MEMORY. Omit when creating a new MEMORY - it will be created for you.
Proactively call this tool when you:

1. Identify a new USER preference.
2. Receive an explicit USER request to remember something or otherwise alter your behavior.
3. Are working and want to record important context.
4. Identify that an existing MEMORY is incorrect or outdated.
Create and update require non-null content. Update and delete require an existing memory in this user's namespace; an unchanged update makes no write.

function.name: search_memory

function.name: read_record
function.description: Read one existing memory or State by its exact scoped id.

function.name: reserve_and_label
function.description: Reserve an item for the current user and attempt its label. A failed label may leave a real reservation. One call is one attempt.

item_key.description: Copy the complete item reference including qualifiers; use this same exact key for later reads.

function.name: get_reservation
function.description: Read the current user's actual reservation and label state for an item.

item_key.description: Copy the complete item reference including qualifiers; use the exact key used for the reservation.

function.name: complete_label
function.description: Create the label for the current user's existing reservation. This does not reserve again or dispatch anything.

function.description:
Create, update, or delete a memory to persist across conversations.
Include the MEMORY ID when updating or deleting a MEMORY. Omit when creating a new MEMORY - it will be created for you.
Proactively call this tool when you:

1. Identify a new USER preference.
2. Receive an explicit USER request to remember something or otherwise alter your behavior.
3. Are working and want to record important context.
4. Identify that an existing MEMORY is incorrect or outdated.
Create and update require non-null content. Update and delete require an existing memory in this user's namespace; an unchanged update makes no write.

item_key.description: Copy the complete item reference including qualifiers; use this same exact key for later reads.

function.name: get_reservation
function.description: Read the current user's actual reservation and label state for an item.

item_key.description: Copy the complete item reference including qualifiers; use the exact key used for the reservation.

function.name: complete_label
function.description: Create the label for the current user's existing reservation. This does not reserve again or dispatch anything.

function.description:
Create, update, or delete a memory to persist across conversations.
Include the MEMORY ID when updating or deleting a MEMORY. Omit when creating a new MEMORY - it will be created for you.
Proactively call this tool when you:

1. Identify a new USER preference.
2. Receive an explicit USER request to remember something or otherwise alter your behavior.
3. Are working and want to record important context.
4. Identify that an existing MEMORY is incorrect or outdated.
Create and update require non-null content. Update and delete require an existing memory in this user's namespace; an unchanged update makes no write.

function.name: manage_memory
function.description:
Create, update, or delete a memory to persist across conversations.
Include the MEMORY ID when updating or deleting a MEMORY. Omit when creating a new MEMORY - it will be created for you.
Proactively call this tool when you:

1. Identify a new USER preference.
2. Receive an explicit USER request to remember something or otherwise alter your behavior.
3. Are working and want to record important context.
4. Identify that an existing MEMORY is incorrect or outdated.
Create and update require non-null content. Update and delete require an existing memory in this user's namespace; an unchanged update makes no write.

function.description:
Create, update, or delete a memory to persist across conversations.
Include the MEMORY ID when updating or deleting a MEMORY. Omit when creating a new MEMORY - it will be created for you.
Proactively call this tool when you:

1. Identify a new USER preference.
2. Receive an explicit USER request to remember something or otherwise alter your behavior.
3. Are working and want to record important context.
4. Identify that an existing MEMORY is incorrect or outdated.
Create and update require non-null content. Update and delete require an existing memory in this user's namespace; an unchanged update makes no write.

function.name: search_memory
function.description: Search your long-term memories for information relevant to your current context.

function.name: read_record
function.description: Read one existing memory or State by its exact scoped id.

function.name: maintain_records
function.description: Request a fresh memory and State maintenance proposal. The reason is a request, not evidence; this returns actual per-tool receipts. An empty proposal means no change, not an answer to the user.

function.name: reserve_and_label
function.description: Reserve an item for the current user and attempt its label. A failed label may leave a real reservation. One call is one attempt.

item_key.description: Copy the complete item reference including qualifiers; use this same exact key for later reads.

function.name: get_reservation
function.description: Read the current user's actual reservation and label state for an item.

item_key.description: Copy the complete item reference including qualifiers; use the exact key used for the reservation.

function.name: complete_label
function.description: Create the label for the current user's existing reservation. This does not reserve again or dispatch anything.
